name: upol
_comment: UPOL TYPO3 ext "cookies" (SBTheke). First layer has only Povolit vše; Více... opens the category form, where Analytické can be pre-checked: untick it (and Propagační if ticked), then Potvrdit výběr (sets tx_cookies_type_essential=1 only). The panel loses .in at once, then the page reloads. Top-200 CZ run 2026-11-23. Exception to the end-with-a-check convention: the form's onsubmit reloads the page at once, so a check step never finishes and the result is lost; the reload itself shows the choice took (the banner is gone after it).
